description: Shapes Are Everywhere (br11) models: a toy shape sorter box (a purple cube with circle, square, triangle, star and heart holes on its cream top, where matching flat shape pieces drop in) and a standing heart greeting card. Same format as ../models.json. Props face +z and stand on y = 0.

shape_sorter.description: A toy shape sorter box for Shapes Are Everywhere (br11): a purple cube 1.1 m wide, deep and tall at size 1 (origin at the middle of its base, front +z) with a cream top plate (top surface at y 1.13) holding five dark holes, and five little coloured shape pictures across the front (red circle, blue square, green triangle, yellow star, pink heart). Hole centres on the top at size 1 (x, z): circle (-0.32, -0.24), square (0, -0.24), triangle (0.32, -0.24), star (-0.17, 0.22), heart (0.17, 0.22), each 0.27 m across. A flat shape object of size 0.24 turned [-90, 0, 0] (lying face up; it then reaches from at toward -z, so put at.z = hole z + 0.12 x its height factor) fits a hole; move it down through the top (below y 1.1 it is hidden inside the box) and hide it. Big shapes (size 0.62 or less) behind it at z -0.95 are fully hidden from a camera in front.

heart_card.description: A standing greeting card with a big red heart on the front for Shapes Are Everywhere (br11): a cream card 0.6 m wide and 0.8 m tall in a pink border, facing +z, propped up by a back flap (origin at the middle of its base). The heart's centre is at [0, 0.43, 0.09], 0.38 m across: draw a heart outline around it there.
